product.title: Rainbow Mountain Trek from Cusco with Breakfast & Lunch -Full Day

description.text: In Cusco, this full-day Rainbow Mountain trek drives through highland countryside to Quessiuno for breakfast before the hike to Vinicunca Mountain. A guide covers local flora and fauna on the climb, with optional horses available in the first town at extra cost. Breakfast and lunch are included; the mountain entrance fee is collected separately in soles. Drop-off is at Plaza Regocijo, one block from the central plaza. The published duration is about 12 hours, and the summit window looks toward snow-capped Ausangate when weather is clear. The format suits visitors who want a guided colored-mountain day without self-driving the dirt approach. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on Quessiuno and Vinicunca Mountain that shape this hike rather than a Palcoyo or ATV variant.

highlights: Travel for a few hours from Cusco through the rugged mountain countryside of Peru to reach the aptly named Rainbow Mount
Hike with a guide to the summit, or rent a horse (own expense) for easier access to the same views
Entrance to the mountain is not included
